title: Use gRPC health checks instead of TCP probes for gRPC services
description:
**Severity: HIGH**

**File**: `deploy/k8s/base.yaml`
- context-engine (lines 215-222, port 50070)
- safety-kernel (lines 278-285, port 50051)

**Issue**: Both gRPC services use `tcpSocket` probes which only validate TCP connection, not gRPC service health. A service can accept TCP connections while its gRPC endpoint is broken (e.g., dependency failure, deadlock).

```yaml
livenessProbe:
  tcpSocket: {port: 50070}
```

**Fix**: Use gRPC native health checks:
```yaml
livenessProbe:
  grpc:
    port: 50070
```
Requires k8s 1.24+ and the services to implement the gRPC health checking protocol.
definitionOfDone: Both gRPC services use grpc health probes instead of tcpSocket
Services implement gRPC health checking protocol
Health checks detect actual gRPC failures

implementationPlan.description:
Add gRPC health checking protocol to the **context-engine** server (`cmd/cordum-context-engine/main.go:60-64`). After `pb.RegisterContextEngineServer(server, svc)`, add:
```go
import "google.golang.org/grpc/health"
import healthpb "google.golang.org/grpc/health/grpc_health_v1"

healthServer := health.NewServer()
healthpb.RegisterHealthServer(server, healthServer)
healthServer.SetServingStatus("", healthpb.HealthCheckResponse_SERVING)
```
The empty-string service name is the default health check target for k8s probes.

Add gRPC health checking protocol to the **safety-kernel** server (`core/controlplane/safetykernel/kernel.go:110`). After `grpcServer := grpc.NewServer(serverCreds)`, register the health server the same way.

Update `deploy/k8s/base.yaml` to use gRPC native probes for both services:

**context-engine** (lines 215-222):
```yaml
livenessProbe:
  grpc:
    port: 50070
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 10
readinessProbe:
  grpc:
    port: 50070
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 10
```

**safety-kernel** (lines 278-285): Same pattern with port 50051.
Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-context-engine/... ./core/controlplane/safetykernel/...` to verify compilation. Run `go test ./core/controlplane/safetykernel/...` to verify no regressions.
